title: Students Plant Trees
text:
Last week, students at Green Hill School planted thirty trees in the park. A local news team came to see the event. The students worked for three hours in the sun. Their teacher said the trees will help clean the air.

Many people in the town were happy about the work. The mayor came to the park and thanked the students. He said the park will be more beautiful in the spring. The students want to plant more trees next year.

questions.text: How many trees did the students plant?
Who came to the park and thanked the students?
What was the main reason the students planted the trees?
options: They wanted to help the town and the air
They wanted to win a prize
The mayor forced them to do it
They wanted to sell the trees

questions.text: What can we guess about the students after this event?
options: They are proud of their work
They will stop going to school
They are angry at the mayor
They do not want to help again

vocabulary.definition: people who are learning at a school, college or university
a public area with grass and trees where people can relax
the person who leads the government of a town or city

paragraph_translations: Geçen hafta Green Hill Okulu'ndaki öğrenciler parkta otuz ağaç dikti. Yerel haber ekibi etkinliği görmek için geldi. Öğrenciler güneşin altında üç saat çalıştı. Öğretmenleri ağaçların havayı temizlemeye yardımcı olacağını söyledi.

Kasabadaki birçok insan yapılan işten memnun oldu. Belediye başkanı parka gelip öğrencilere teşekkür etti. Baharda parkın çok daha güzel olacağını söyledi. Öğrenciler gelecek yıl daha fazla ağaç dikmek istiyor.
